high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter feed. The top part of the screen shows the time as 9:33, along with icons indicating the phone's battery level (49%) and connectivity status. Below that, there is a search bar labeled "Search Twitter" and a settings icon. The main content of the image is a tweet from the official SpaceX account. The tweet includes an image of Joe Biden looking down with a somewhat somber expression. The tweet reads: "This was Biden watching @elonmusk and @SpaceX make history this weekend."
